what: GPU (web/shaders/crt/gpu.mjs) against the CPU reference (web/shaders/crt/crt.mjs) for the physical CRT
compare: 8-bit sRGB from the display encode (encode8 / glass.mjs encode8), exposure 1, per channel, all pixels
why_not_bit_equal: The GPU computes in f32 and the CPU reference in f64; erf, exp and pow differ in the last bits, and a pixel whose footprint edge lands on a stripe or slot boundary can round differently. The bound allows that and nothing structural.
